title: Time checks with an injected clock
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time; HCERT Specification, 3.2.6 Issued At. QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards: “Decode the CBOR payload and check exp and iat against the current time.”. HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time: “after which a Verifier MUST reject the Payload as expired”.

statements.label: Time checks with an injected clock
statements.requirement: The verifier SHALL reject a certificate whose exp is in the past, and one whose iat is in the future beyond a configurable clock-skew tolerance. The current time SHALL be passed in by the caller (now), never read from an ambient clock.
